test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan, 2024 Shift 1).
subject: general
question: A boat is moving 3 km against the current of the stream in 1 hour and moves 1 km in the direction of the current in 12 minutes. How long will it take the boat to go 6 km in stationary water?
solution:
**Given:**

A boat is moving 3 km against the current of the stream in 1 hour and moves 1 km in the direction of the current in 12 minutes.

**Formula used:**

Speed of the boat in still water = (1/2) × (Speed against the current + Speed with the current)
